title: Concurrent Child Order Mass Cancellation Across 1,000 Accounts
precondition: 1,000 child limit orders working at broker.
expected_result: Mass cancellation cancels all 1,000 child orders within 600ms; zero orphan limit orders.
actual_result: Mass cancellation endpoint (POST /v1/oms/{instance}/orders/bulk/cancel) cancels all working child limit orders in unison.
